title: Unusual rate of carcass decay on the ranch

tellings.quote: the rate of decay and decomposition on Skinwalker Ranch is dramatically different than anything that that has been observed in nature typically

plain: Dead animals on Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for reports of strange events, decay and decompose at a rate "dramatically different" from anything usually seen in nature, according to the ranch's owner, Brandon Fugal. He tells it from the years his team has run the place, mentioning a man named Ben Woodruff in connection with it, as a sign that something on the land affects living matter.
